The admin dashboard in motion

The day at a glance

Bookings, hours in use, money paid and money still owed, for any day.

    01 · Why it matters

    From notes by hand
    to one live view.

    • For staff

      BeforeRecord every booking by hand.

      NowEach booking from the website appears in the schedule by itself.

    • For the owner

      BeforeTrack bookings and payments by hand.

      NowSee what's booked and paid in one place, and update prices and hours there too.

    02 · Monitor bookings

    The timetable
    updates itself.

    When a customer books on the website, the booking appears in the timetable straight away. Nobody has to type it in or refresh the page.

    • Every table, every hourGaps and clashes are easy to spot, and colours show what's paid, due at the counter or waiting for a check.
    • Today's numbersBookings, hours in use, money paid and money still owed sit at the top.
    • Details when neededOpen any booking for its details, or download the day's list as a CSV.

    03 · Live tables

    Know when
    time is up.

    Every table has a countdown to the end of its booking, so staff know when to stop a game without checking the list.

    • BlueThe game is running and there's plenty of time left.
    • OrangeTen minutes left, with the next booking shown beside it.
    • RedTime's up, and the timer counts the overtime.

    04 · Payments

    Check the proof.
    Confirm the table.

    From proof to paid in two taps

    When a customer uploads a QRIS payment, it waits here. Staff open the proof, compare the amount with the payment received, then approve or reject it.

    • Reject with a reasonA rejected payment goes back to the customer with a note explaining why.
    • Tables don't stay stuckBookings with no proof after 30 minutes cancel themselves, so the table is free again.
    • Everything updatesOnce approved, the booking shows as paid in the schedule.

    05 · Ratings

    See the ratings.
    Improve the visit.

    When a customer sends feedback from the website, it lands here. The team can see what people liked and what to fix.

    →
    • Connected to the websiteThe feedback button is on every customer page, and every message arrives here.
    • The average at a glanceAn overall rating shows how visits are going.
    • Filter by starsGo straight to the low ratings to find what needs fixing.

    06 · Settings

    Update the website.
    No code needed.

    The owner can change what customers see from the dashboard, in Indonesian and English, without asking for a developer.

    • The words on the websiteHeadlines, buttons and step-by-step text can all be edited.
    • Promos with a previewSet the dates and see how the promo will look before saving.
    • The running of the venueTables, prices, opening hours and venue details all live here too.

    07 · Owner access

    Only people
    the owner adds.

    Bookings and customer details stay private. Only Google accounts on the owner's list can open the dashboard, and anyone else is told they don't have access.

    • The owner decidesThe owner adds accounts by email and removes them at any time.
    • Two levels of accessEach account is either an owner or staff.
    • Settings stay with ownersStaff don't see Settings or the website text.

    Try it yourself.
